# Request Board demo script

For the presenter and new team leads. Rehearsed on 2026-09-28 against http://127.0.0.1:5199/
(static single-page app, no backend, no model). All navigation is hash-routing and renders
synchronously; page-transition timings are marked **estimate** because they were not timed in
a browser session — team to validate on the demo machine.

**Changes since the rehearsal.** None yet.

---
